description: Confirmatory survey-weighted tests (2023-2024) of patterns suggested by boosting
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity; train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: SurveyLogit (Taylor linearisation, PSUSTRAT/PSU_VAR, design df) with all circumstance-stage covariates + vehicle-age bands; product term or non-linearity terms; Holm across candidates
